snippet.title: C64 Longplay: Amazon Warrior
snippet.description:
Released in 1985 by New Generation Software and programmed by Geoff Sumner.
This ripped off Forbidden Forest but possibly improves it because it is so hard I can't complete it without save-states (emulator tools). This is not possible without cheats. And after all that effort... nothing. The journey is better than the destination.

ADVERT: https://archive.org/details/zzapp_64_issue_003_600dpi/page/n19/mode/2up
